faq1q: What type of companies do you work with?
faq1a: Companies with 50–500 people in operations-heavy sectors: hotels, clinics, professional services, retail and mid-market manufacturing.
faq2a: Depends on your starting point. Without clarity on your tech ecosystem, we start with a Digital Radiography. If you already have a diagnosis, we go straight to Roadmap or Implementation.
faq3a: Yes, by default. We sign an NDA before the first discovery session.
faq4a: We reply within 24 hours at most. If it's urgent, WhatsApp is the fastest channel.
faq5q: Which languages can we work in?
faq5a: Spanish, Portuguese and English: meetings, documentation and deliverables in whichever language your team prefers.
faq6q: What should I include in my first message?
faq6a: How many people work at the company, which systems you use (ERP, CRM, PMS, POS or in-house software) and which operational problem costs you the most today. That way the first conversation starts from your case, not from a generic pitch.
